text:
Devlin: seeing a surge of long-lived gRPC streams stalling from eu-west -> inference-pool since ~2026-03-17T02:30Z. clients hang 60-180s then RESET
maria_s: mobile-prod alerted too. envoy shows RST_STREAM + occasional GOAWAYs and a bunch of WINDOW_UPDATE churn
ops-bot: alert: h2_stream_reset_rate_high (edge-egress-prod, eu-west) at 2026-03-17T02:34:10Z
arjun_k: suspect HTTP/2 flow-control clamping between ALB -> nginx-ingress -> envoy. can we grab h2 counters and tcpdump?
Devlin: dumping envoy stats now; top counters:
Devlin: ```
http2.rx.stream_reset: 512
cluster.egress.upstream_streams_closed: 518
server.h2.connection_window_updates_sent: 14
server.h2.stream_window_update_clamped: 168
```
helen: stream_window_update_clamped that high points at window updates being throttled or dropped downstream
chloe: timeline: any infra rollouts around 02:15-02:25? infra-deploy shows a keepalive tuning + buffer tweak pushed to edge nodes at 02:18
maria_s: confirmed config push to edge-proxy-chain at 02:18 — tune to keepalive=60s and nginx proxy_buffering=true for the route. @infra-team rolled it
Devlin: tcpdump from repro session shows a repeating pattern: client sends WINDOW_UPDATE, server responds with large DATA, then client does not send further WINDOW_UPDATE for 20-40s and we see RST
Devlin: ```
CLIENT -> SERVER: WINDOW_UPDATE stream_id=0 inc=65535
SERVER -> CLIENT: DATA ... (big chunk)
(no WINDOW_UPDATE from CLIENT for 30s)
SERVER -> CLIENT: RST_STREAM
```
helen: that looks like backpressure from a buffering layer. nginx in front of envoy has historically caused double-buffering and delayed WINDOW_UPDATEs
arjun_k: plus ALB may be buffering or chunking differently. mismatched initial_window_size / connection_window_size across hops can deadlock flow-control when proxies buffer entire responses
chloe: other impact: when streams stall, the inference worker threads keep KV cache pinned and hold GPU memory longer -> short-term capacity pressure and queued requests spike
Devlin: agreed. mitigation options: temporarily increase connection_window_size and initial_window_size on edge-proxy and ALB, disable nginx proxy_buffering for the gRPC path, and enable frequent http2 pings to detect stalled peers earlier
maria_s: rolling a hotfix: revert the 02:18 keepalive change, set connection_window_size=16777216 (16MB) on edge-proxy, and set proxy_buffering off for /v1/stream on nginx-ingress
ops-bot: deploy-start: edge-proxy-hotfix by maria_s at 2026-03-17T03:05:00Z
Devlin: applied hotfix in eu-west; watching metrics (stream resets, h2.unacked_windows, GPU queue depth)
arjun_k: can we add a metric for h2.streams_unacked_window and per-node conntrack_count? alert if unacked_window > 100 for 3m or conntrack_count > 80%
helen: also file an infra test: nginx + envoy H2 interplay with long-lived gRPC streams and large responses, run in staging with simulated high concurrency
chloe: creating perf test harness and playbook in eng-infra/playbooks. will document steps to reproduce and add tcpdump + envoy config lens
maria_s: hotfix looks effective: stream_reset rate down ~80% in last 10m and GPU queue depth is back to normal. rolling to staging verification before cross-region rollout
Devlin: adding runbook entry: "gRPC flow-control stalls -> check nginx proxy_buffering / H2 window clamping / conntrack" and include the tcpdump snippet and envoy counters
ops-bot: deploy-finish: edge-proxy-hotfix by maria_s succeeded at 2026-03-17T03:09:22Z
arjun_k: follow-up: tune ALB H2 settings in ap-south and eu-central; might need higher conn windows or dedicated egress pools for long-lived streams to avoid head-of-line blocking for short inference calls
chloe: we should also consider carving a dedicated inference egress fleet (dedicated GPUs) for persistent/chatty sessions so short requests don't get stuck behind large streamed responses
Devlin: closing thread for now. will reopen if stream_reset regression >10% in next 24h. thanks all.
